sections.heading: Section 1: Probability Distribution Tables & Total Probability

questions.q: The random variable $X$ has probability distribution $P(X = x) = c(x^2 + 1)$ for $x = 0, 1, 2, 3$. Find the constant $c$.
A fair die is rolled. Let $X$ be the number of rolls until a 6 appears. What kind of distribution does $X$ follow?
questions.answer: The number of independent Bernoulli trials until the first success is modeled by the Geometric distribution.

questions.q: Given the probability distribution of $Y$: $P(Y = -1) = 0.3, P(Y = 0) = 0.4, P(Y = 2) = 0.3$. Find $P(Y \geq 0)$.
Find the expectation $E(X)$ for the distribution: $P(X = 1) = 0.1, P(X = 2) = 0.3, P(X = 3) = 0.4, P(X = 4) = 0.2$.
A game charges 5 dollars to play. A fair coin is tossed: Heads pays 8 dollars, Tails pays nothing. What is the expected net gain for the player?
questions.answer: Expected payout $= 0.5(8) + 0.5(0) = 4$ dollars. Net gain $= 4 - 5 = -1.00$ dollar.

questions.q: Calculate the standard deviation of $X$ given $P(X = 0) = 0.5$ and $P(X = 2) = 0.5$.
Two fair 4-sided dice (numbered 1 to 4) are rolled. Let $S$ be the sum of the two numbers. Find $P(S > 5)$.
questions.answer: Total outcomes $= 16$. Pairs with sum $> 5$: sum 6 has (2,4), (3,3), (4,2) (3 pairs); sum 7 has (3,4), (4,3) (2 pairs); sum 8 has (4,4) (1 pair). Total favorable $= 3 + 2 + 1 = 6$. Probability $= 6/16 = 3/8$.

questions.q: For the sum $S$ of the two 4-sided dice in the previous question, what is $E(S)$?
